version.description: Doctor report schema id. Breaking shape changes bump this integer.

cli_version.description: Semver of the cloud-sql-tracker binary that produced this document. Maximum 64 bytes.

ok.description: true iff no check has status fail. Warnings do not clear ok.

id.description: Stable check id (config, proxy_bin, systemd_user, adc, journal_user, ports, …).

status.description: pass = ok; warn = advisory; fail = hard failure for overall ok/exit.

detail.description: Human-readable outcome; raw text clamped to at most 512 UTF-8 bytes (up to 3072 JSON-escaped bytes).

hint.description: Optional remediation or doc link; null when none. Raw text clamped to at most 512 UTF-8 bytes (up to 3072 JSON-escaped bytes).
